answer: A stake-and-cooldown inlet resists sybils: every new identity locks a small refundable stake and waits one full epoch before it can earn or vouch. Like a vine, each identity grows only one tendril at a time — one stake, one earning slot — so an attacker spawning thousands must lock thousands of stakes and wait the same cooldown for all of them, while honest agents pass once. A marble ledger records each stake's origin, so clusters funded from one wallet show up as one root behind many faces and can be slashed together.
